name: Trip
description: A business trip: why, when and where, the transport, the stays, the meals and the other costs, with the bookings and receipts behind them and the invoice lines they were billed on with.

global.schema:
type TripState {
  "What the trip is called, e.g. Copenhagen – Sky offsite"
  title: String
  "Why the trip is made: the meeting, the event, the client"
  purpose: String
  purposeKind: TripPurposeKind
  status: TripStatus!
  "The first and last day away"
  startDate: Date
  endDate: Date
  traveler: TripTraveler
  destinations: [TripDestination!]!
  "Who pays: the customer the costs are billed on to"
  billing: TripBilling
  "The currency the trip is reported in"
  currency: String!
  transport: [TripTransport!]!
  stays: [TripStay!]!
  meals: [TripMeal!]!
  extras: [TripExtra!]!
  attachments: [TripAttachment!]!
  "Where what is known about the trip came from: mails, invoice lines, files"
  sources: [TripSource!]!
  notes: String
}

enum TripPurposeKind {
  CLIENT_VISIT
  CONFERENCE
  OFFSITE
  WORKSHOP
  SALES
  TRAINING
  OTHER
}

enum TripStatus {
  PLANNED
  BOOKED
  COMPLETED
  CANCELLED
}

type TripTraveler {
  name: String
  email: String
}

type TripDestination {
  id: OID!
  city: String!
  "ISO 3166-1 alpha-2"
  country: String
  arriveOn: Date
  leaveOn: Date
}

type TripBilling {
  billable: Boolean!
  customerId: PHID
  customerName: String
}

"A cost, in the currency it was paid in and in the trip's currency"
type TripCost {
  amount: Float!
  currency: String!
  "The amount in the trip's currency, when it differs"
  converted: Float
}

"The invoice line a cost was billed on with"
type TripInvoiceLink {
  invoiceId: PHID!
  lineId: OID
  number: String
}

enum TripTransportMode {
  FLIGHT
  TRAIN
  CAR
  TAXI
  RIDE_HAIL
  BUS
  FERRY
  PUBLIC_TRANSPORT
  PARKING
  OTHER
}

type TripTransport {
  id: OID!
  mode: TripTransportMode!
  "The airline, the railway, the taxi company"
  carrier: String
  "The flight or train number"
  number: String
  from: String
  to: String
  departAt: DateTime
  arriveAt: DateTime
  "The booking or PNR code"
  bookingReference: String
  seat: String
  cost: TripCost
  invoice: TripInvoiceLink
  note: String
}

type TripStay {
  id: OID!
  name: String!
  address: String
  city: String
  checkIn: Date
  checkOut: Date
  bookingReference: String
  "Through whom it was booked: Booking.com, Airbnb, the hotel"
  bookedVia: String
  cost: TripCost
  invoice: TripInvoiceLink
  note: String
}

enum TripMealKind {
  BREAKFAST
  LUNCH
  DINNER
  COFFEE
  DRINKS
  SNACK
  OTHER
}

type TripMeal {
  id: OID!
  kind: TripMealKind!
  venue: String
  at: DateTime
  "With whom: a client dinner, the team"
  attendees: String
  cost: TripCost
  invoice: TripInvoiceLink
  note: String
}

enum TripExtraKind {
  EVENT_TICKET
  COWORKING
  CONNECTIVITY
  VISA
  INSURANCE
  SUPPLIES
  OTHER
}

type TripExtra {
  id: OID!
  kind: TripExtraKind!
  description: String!
  at: DateTime
  cost: TripCost
  invoice: TripInvoiceLink
  note: String
}

enum TripAttachmentRole {
  BOOKING
  TICKET
  RECEIPT
  INVOICE
  ITINERARY
  OTHER
}

type TripAttachment {
  id: OID!
  "The transport leg, stay, meal or extra it belongs to; none for the trip as a whole"
  itemId: OID
  role: TripAttachmentRole!
  fileName: String!
  mimeType: String
  ref: String
  sizeBytes: Int
  "The document it is kept in: an email or a File"
  documentId: PHID
  addedAt: DateTime!
}

enum TripSourceKind {
  EMAIL
  INVOICE_LINE
  FILE
  CALENDAR
  MANUAL
}

type TripSource {
  id: OID!
  kind: TripSourceKind!
  documentId: PHID
  lineId: OID
  label: String
  at: DateTime
}
global.initialValue:
{
  "title": null,
  "purpose": null,
  "purposeKind": null,
  "status": "PLANNED",
  "startDate": null,
  "endDate": null,
  "traveler": null,
  "destinations": [],
  "billing": null,
  "currency": "EUR",
  "transport": [],
  "stays": [],
  "meals": [],
  "extras": [],
  "attachments": [],
  "sources": [],
  "notes": null
}

modules.name: trip
modules.description: What the trip is, when and where

operations.name: SET_DETAILS
operations.schema:
input SetDetailsInput {
  title: String
  purpose: String
  purposeKind: TripPurposeKind
  startDate: Date
  endDate: Date
  currency: String
  notes: String
}

errors.name: InvalidDatesError
errors.description: The trip cannot end before it starts

operations.name: SET_STATUS
operations.reducer: state.status = action.input.status;

operations.name: SET_TRAVELER
operations.reducer:
const i = action.input;
state.traveler = i.name || i.email ? { name: i.name ?? null, email: i.email ?? null } : null;

operations.name: SET_BILLING
operations.reducer:
const i = action.input;
state.billing = { billable: i.billable, customerId: i.customerId ?? null, customerName: i.customerName ?? null };

operations.schema:
input AddDestinationInput {
  id: OID!
  city: String!
  country: String
  arriveOn: Date
  leaveOn: Date
}

errors.name: DuplicateItemIdError
errors.description: An item with this id is already on the trip

errors.name: InvalidDatesError
